description_en: Queries the identifier list of a single device in the unique-certificate-per-product authentication scenario without pre-registration
description_zh: 一型一密免注册场景下，调用该接口查看单个设备的标识列表
name: QueryClientIds

parameters.help_en: The device ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257184.html operation to query the IotId
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>the ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id
